summary: One Georgia tower list entry places a griffin lookout in Spalding County (listed as Spaulding); no build, agency, staffing or fate source found.

evidence.supports: list row: griffin, Spaulding county spelling, coordinates
the county is Spalding County, with the courthouse in Griffin
evidence.quote: Spalding County Courthouse has been the name of successive courthouses of Spalding County, Georgia in Griffin, Georgia

corrections.why: The county is Spalding County; the tnlandforms list spells it Spaulding

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only the tnlandforms row supports the entry; its datasheet code is unexplained and not used. Searches of the Griffin and Spalding County sources, and the cached Forest Lookouts Georgia index, found no Griffin tower. No source read gives a build date, agency, staffing, status, access or photos, so the story is about 40 words on purpose. The proposed correction (Spaulding to Spalding County) is for human review. Brief status unknown and access unknown are left as they are.
